aim: Check ALFRED official browser-visible public download form as a keyless authorized alternative for point-in-time NFCI/ANFCI values, without trying to bypass access controls.
approach: With session cookies from public GET, submit the same listed POST fields of public ALFRED form, no CAPTCHA bypass and no credentials. Request one vintage per series/date using form[entered_vintage_dates], form[file_type] and form[file_format] discovered from actual form options; preserve submitted field names, response Content-Type, SHA and source URL; no secret values.
validation: Accept only ZIP with CRC valid + data text containing explicit requested vintage date and numeric NFCI/ANFCI observation with observation date no later than vintage; otherwise STATUS_BLOCKED and never assign a macro factor.
scope: At most 4 public form POSTs total, <5 MB each. No trading adjustments. Report pilot status in new R2 prefix and readback SHA.
noPITShortcut: ALFRED public HTML form being accessible does not equal archival vintage numeric access. No use of current backfilled chart as authentic vintage.
